en.tagline: Build and preview a hosted business website from a brief
en.summary: Website Builder turns a plain-language brief into a hosted business website you can preview before it goes live. It starts with a homepage and can add bookings, checkout, or a member area when the business needs them. After launch, it can automate booking reminders, lead follow-ups, and weekly reports.
problem: A business owner wants a website but has to explain it to a builder, review drafts, and decide when to publish. This skill takes a short description and builds a preview on the hosted service. The owner reviews the preview and chooses when to go live.
Changes and automations use the same task flow. Each one is previewed and approved before it reaches the live site.
fit: A new business homepage, landing page, or service showcase
A portfolio or online store on the hosted builder
Updates to an existing site hosted by this builder
Adding reminders or weekly reports after launch
unfit: Sites on another host, or local codebases, when the user asks for that path
General advice, which the skill answers in chat without building anything
steps: The skill connects to the service through MCP or the command-line tool and selects the company the user named.
It checks credits and gets the user's approval before any build or edit uses them.
It builds the first website from the brief as a preview, or sends requested changes as a task for an existing site.
It follows each task, relays any questions or blocks, and shares the preview link with the user.
When the user asks to go live, it checks that the reviewed draft is unchanged and publishes after approval.
After launch, it can set up automations such as booking reminders or weekly reports once the user approves them.

zh.tagline: 根据简短描述搭建并预览托管的企业网站
zh.summary: Website Builder 可以把一段白话描述变成托管的企业网站，上线前你可以先预览。网站从首页开始，需要时可以加入预约、结账或会员区。上线后，它还能自动发送预约提醒、跟进线索，并生成每周报告。
problem: 企业主想要一个网站，但通常要向搭建者说明需求、审阅草稿，并决定何时发布。这个技能根据简短描述，在托管服务上生成预览版本。企业主审阅预览，并自行决定何时上线。
修改和自动化任务使用同一套流程。每项内容在进入正式站点前，都要先预览并获得批准。
fit: 新建企业首页、落地页或服务展示页
在该托管平台上搭建作品集或在线商店
更新由本搭建工具托管的现有网站
上线后添加提醒或每周报告
unfit: 用户指定其他主机或本地代码库时的网站
一般性建议，技能只在聊天中回答，不会搭建任何内容
steps: 技能通过 MCP 或命令行工具连接服务，并选择用户指定的公司。
在任何搭建或修改消耗积分之前，先检查积分并获得用户批准。
根据需求生成首个网站的预览版本；对已有网站，则把修改需求作为任务提交。
跟进每个任务，转达其中的问题或阻塞情况，并把预览链接分享给用户。
用户要求上线时，先确认已审阅的草稿未变，再在获得批准后发布。
上线后，经用户批准，可以设置预约提醒、每周报告等自动化任务。
